newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain is too old fashioned -- official says.
newsitem.headline: Spain is too old fashioned -- official says.

text.p: Spain is too old fashioned and must undergo a radical modernisation to realise its potential, a senior Spanish official said on Thursday.
Jose Maria Michavila, state secretary for Congress relations, said Spain needed to further reduce the role of the state in the economy as a first step toward modernisation.
"Spain has tremendous potential but is old fashioned. We need to modernise the whole society. It is a society which still does not have enough backbone," said Michavila.

He said the conservative Popular Party government was moving in the right direction. The government has intensified privatisations and embarked on an ambitious programme of fiscal restraint since it came to power in May.

"Since 1921, Spain has followed a course of action centred on nationalisation. It has a very high state presence," said Michavila. "I'm surprised by the persistence of the view in Spain that public is good and private is bad."
He was speaking at a conference on the Spanish political economy organised by The Economist.
